analyst.summary: Aavas is an affordable-housing lender that continues to grow its loan book at a healthy mid-teens pace while keeping bad-loan levels among the lowest in its peer group, and its most recent quarter showed profit growth accelerating. The company went through a full change of controlling shareholder over the last two years (one private-equity owner selling to another), but the day-to-day business has kept performing well through that transition. Given the strong growth and asset quality trend and a valuation that is no longer expensive, we view this as a hold.
